Compatibility and integrations

Bonus-damage setup and compatibility. Automated damage riders such as Sneak Attack, Hex, and Hunter's Mark are based on the Foundry D&D 5.5e Player's Handbook items and activities. Automation may also work with characters imported from D&D Beyond, but those imports have not been tested.

Built for Foundry VTT v14 and D&D5e 6.0.5+, tested with 6.0.6. No additional module dependencies are required.

ModuleTested versionRecorded integration

The October 12, 2026 test setup includes 47 companion modules. Being enabled in that world is not individual compatibility certification. Carousel Combat Tracker has a separately recorded error and needs further testing.
